identity.scope: Ready train and validation only; already-imported tie pointers, not XML declaration truth

limitations: Imported tie pointers are not complete XML truth; import omissions are not measured.
Cross-bar deletion is distinguished from erroneous same-bar deletion.
Window tie statistics include written segments; event statistics apply original cache validity filters.
Score-event counts are neither audible onset counts nor physical release labels.
Test-read flags refer only to this audit runner, not to all work in the wider conversation.
Failed audit cases remain in the selected denominator and are excluded from completed statistics.
Raw note/event IDs, array contents and individual warning messages remain local.
